title: Release Packaging And Distribution
problem: Taru has a verified self-hosted release baseline but still lacks an operator-facing artifact, container, startup preflight, release script, and packaging documentation path.
summary: Turn source-built Taru into a packageable and diagnosable self-hosted distribution while deciding the next product lane after packaging.

continue_policy.notes: Release packaging and distribution lane completed. Recommended next lane: Metadata Provider Breadth; split Downloads as managed-import-staging if prioritized.
